agent reported a spec/test contradiction:
# BLOCKED: P3.FREETEXT

Two frozen tests in `tests/flows/test_intake_events.py` contradict other frozen tests and SPEC §3.3 item 5 / §1 inv. 2:

- `test_declared_risk_answer_rebuilds_limits_from_rule_and_declared_fields_only` (line ~269)
- `test_notes_answer_unapproved_rules_do_not_reach_limits` (line ~390)

Both assert that no `limits_trace` dependency starts with `LLM_PREFIXES = ("values.parsed_notes", "risk.behavioural",
"knowledge.question_quality")`. But `rules/limits.py` (`APPROVED_PARSED_RULES = "values.parsed_notes[approved_by_user]"`,
`LIMIT_INPUTS["excluded_activities"]` and `["max_theme_weight"]`) always lists that path in the trace, by design:
the user-approved subset of the parsed rules (a user declaration, §6.2 N3, §7.2) is the limits input, not the
`llm:` field. Frozen tests that REQUIRE this exact path in the trace:

- `tests/profile/test_intake.py::test_invariant_2_trace_names_only_approved_rules_never_the_llm_field` (line 431-432)
- `tests/flows/test_personas.py` lines 347, 348, 374, 488 (`APPROVED_PATH in ... limits_trace ...`)

`str.startswith("values.parsed_notes")` matches `values.parsed_notes[approved_by_user]`, so the new test cannot pass
unless the trace is made conditional (a change to `rules/limits.py`, outside this task's files, and to the
static dependency map of SPEC §3.3 item 5). The other 20 tests of the file pass (all behaviour of the task is
implemented in `intake.py` / `api.py`).

Suggested fix: change the frozen test's check to `d.startswith(LLM_PREFIXES) and "[approved_by_user]" not in d`
(or compare with `!= "values.parsed_notes[approved_by_user]"`).
